lesson.label: Lesson: {title}
term.title: Standard terms
term.body: The code under each field, such as dcterms:creator, is its standard term from Dublin Core. Values are saved under that term, so another archive that reads Dublin Core knows what each value is without asking you.
rename.title: Names and terms
rename.body: You changed the name people see on the form. The value is still saved under the same standard term, so search, exports and other archives read it as before.
fieldsPage.title: Shared fields
fieldsPage.body: Every field here is a term from a shared vocabulary, most often Dublin Core. When two archives both save a creator as dcterms:creator, their records can be searched and merged together.
required.title: Required fields
required.body: This item type marks the field as required, so every item of this type has a value here. A collection where every record has it can be sorted and searched with no gaps.
typeClass.title: Standard classes
typeClass.body: The name is for people. The standard class, such as bibo:Letter, tells software what kind of thing each item is, so a search for that class, here or in another archive, finds every item of this type.
typePick.title: Item types
typePick.body: A type lays out the fields for one kind of thing and saves the item with its standard class. Items of one type share the same fields, so they are easy to compare and to find together.
standards.title: Linked data
standards.body: These are the vocabularies behind every field and class. Each term has a web address, such as http://purl.org/dc/terms/title, so a value saved here means the same thing wherever it is read.
localField.title: Your own vocabulary
localField.body: Its name starts with local: because no shared standard had this field, so it is a term in this archive’s own vocabulary. Its address is on this site, so other archives can still read the value and look up what it means.
switch.label: Show lessons
switch.hint: Short notes that explain the standard behind an action, the first time you take it.
